svg.aria-label: Where the hooks sit. Your computer holds a Claude Code session; inside it, Budgit's hooks wrap every tool Claude uses: Bash, Edit, Write, Read, search, web, MCP and agents. Beside it, five moments where Budgit steps in: session start, each message, before every tool call, when a turn ends, and when the session ends
